---
name: ui-review
description: Critique rendered product UI against explicit requirements, interaction states, visual system, accessibility, and platform behavior.
---

# UI Review

1. Read the explicit product/UI requirements before judging the screen.
2. Inspect the actual implementation and surrounding design system.
3. Review hierarchy, layout, typography, spacing, states, interaction feedback, accessibility, and platform behavior.
4. Check all required controls and edge states, not only the happy-path screenshot.
5. Distinguish design/mockup evidence from running-app evidence.
6. Report concrete mismatches with file/screen references and severity.
7. Do not redesign unrelated screens merely because a different style is preferred.
